$comment: Root ADR-0153. The one place that says which host environment files (groups) exist, which variable names each holds, and which groups every systemd unit and operator run loads. Names only, never values. scripts/deploy/runtime_secrets.py renders the units' EnvironmentFile lines from this file (render; CI refuses a hand edit with check), derives what each unit's and run's scripts require (${NAME:?}, required_env=(...), Python os.environ[...]) and refuses a requirement no loaded group holds, prints a run's systemd-run properties (properties <run>), and on the host, during the deploy, refuses a group file that is missing, owned otherwise or more open than mode, or lacks a name it declares (host). A group's holds may point at the file a name is read from (@<file> for an env example, @<file.json>#/<pointer> for a contract the code reads) instead of copying it. needs maps a name to the group that supplies it; when two loaded groups hold a name, the later one wins and needs must name it. unenumerated names a group a consumer loads for settings its binaries read (the publisher, Spark) that are not listed yet, with the reason; those are the coverage gap, not a permission to add groups.

cloudflare_tokens.$comment: Root ADR-0247. Every Cloudflare credential, recorded once by the token's dashboard name. The variable names its values go by are derived, never written: drop -prod, upper case, - as _, then _TOKEN (api_token) or _ACCESS_KEY_ID and _SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (r2_access_key). A group holds them as @token:<name>. A token renamed later lists its earlier names as renamed_from, in the same order; during the deploy, runtime_secrets.py rename gives a group file that holds an old name the derived one with the same value, then removes the old line once its value is held. The 2026-10-14 renames are complete (no host file holds an old name), so no token lists one.

not_cloudflare.FOUNDATION_PLATFORM_DAWNEER_SERVICE_TOKE: Identity-issued service bearer token (traffic-auth policy registry), not a Cloudflare credential.

not_cloudflare.FOUNDATION_PLATFORM_R2_TILE_PROOF_SECRET: Proof-only test key of the first tile slice, read from TILES_SLICE_PROOF_ENV_FILE outside the repository, never a production token or host file.

not_cloudflare.FOUNDATION_PLATFORM_SHAPE_LEDGER_GITHUB_: A GitHub fine-grained token of the repository's one writer account (contents and pull requests write, this repository only), not a Cloudflare credential: the shape ledger check opens or updates its one refresh pull request with it (root ADR-0259 §5).
